title: Trump administration attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey again
content: The Trump administration is attempting to prosecute James Comey for what it calls a decade-old leak of classified information. Comey's lawyers immediately dismissed the effort as invalid and outside the time limit.

title: Trump administration pushes for food assistance card upgrade to fight fraud
content: The proposed rule is a major step forward in addressing a form of fraud that has robbed SNAP recipients of millions.

title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
content: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.

title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
content: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
content: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.

title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
content: This closed-door gathering that started Monday comes about a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.

title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
content: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan
content: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.

title: How AI is transforming hurricane forecasts
content: Hurricane forecasters are increasingly using artificial intelligence to make predictions.

title: Loggers say Roadless Rule repeal won't solve their biggest challenges
content: President Trump is planning to open up some of the nation's last pristine forests to road building and timber companies. But those who work in the woods say it won't do enough to revive the industry.
